original.label: v0.24 frozen original runtime: public API counters only

oldInstrumented.label: frozen v0.24 core with new FileArtifactStore instrumentation

uncached.label: new core with identical instrumented FileArtifactStore

intermediate.label: new core with bounded logical materialization cache and identical instrumented FileArtifactStore

final.label: final verified build with bounded logical materialization cache

limits: Final cases ran sequentially after root notified completion of the final full verify; no other comparison profile was run concurrently.
Earlier oldInstrumented and uncached profiles ran concurrently. Intermediate could overlap root verification, so cross-profile elapsed ratios are descriptive, not controlled latency estimates.
Elapsed wall time is not CPU time. Scheduler, GC, other applications and OS/filesystem caches are uncontrolled; no wall-time threshold is asserted.
Original v0.24 has public port counters only. OldInstrumented changes only FileArtifactStore instrumentation; the same adapter hash is used by every physical profile.
File metrics count Node file reads and returned bytes, hash input bytes and completed writes. They do not count device reads, cache misses, kernel syscalls or unsuccessful partial I/O bytes.
The fixture has 1,536-byte synthetic item bodies. Its measured phases are collect, checkpoint read, core.calls.get execution/adoption, context preparation and reopen plus preparation.
Reopening creates a fresh ArtifactStore identity, giving the logical materialization cache a cold start. All current-source verification remains subject to runtime checks.
Normalized signatures exclude storage encoding and internal checkpoint references while preserving source contents, amounts, evidence IDs/times/lineage, usage and public copy representation.
No real model, external service, production data or credentials were used.
